command: base="reports/physical_bridge_2026_09_05/silver_superfield_covariance_2026_10_11/";seal=JSON.parse(File.read(base+"PRESEAL_REFINEMENT.json"));inp=JSON.parse(File.read(base+"INPUTS.json"));(seal.fetch("science_files")+inp.fetch("local_inputs")).each{|r|p=r.fetch("path");raise p unless File.size(p)==r.fetch("bytes") && Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==r.fetch("sha256")};rec=JSON.parse(File.read(base+"RECEIPTS.json"));names={"NATIVE_RUN.log"=>"native_final","REFERENCE_RUN.log"=>"reference_final","FOCUSED_RUN.log"=>"focused_final","REGRESSION_RUN.log"=>"regression_final","INTEGRITY_RUN.log"=>"integrity_final","IDENTIFICATION_RUN.log"=>"identification"};names.each{|n,k|r=rec.fetch("all_runs").fetch(k);raise n unless File.size(base+n)==r.fetch("log_bytes") && Digest::SHA256.file(base+n).hexdigest==r.fetch("log_sha256") && r.fetch("exit_code")==0};first=JSON.parse(File.read(base+"FIRST_RECEIPTS.json"));%w[native reference focused regression].each{|k|r=first.fetch(k);n=k.upcase+"_FIRST.log";raise n unless File.size(base+n)==r.fetch("log_bytes") && Digest::SHA256.file(base+n).hexdigest==r.fetch("log_sha256") && r.fetch("exit_code")==0};na=JSON.parse(File.read(base+"NATIVE_RUN.log"));re=JSON.parse(File.read(base+"REFERENCE_RUN.log"));raise "predicate coverage" unless na.fetch("facts").size==42 && na.fetch("facts").values.all? && re.fetch("predicates").size==25 && re.fetch("predicates").values.all?;puts JSON.generate({science_hashes:7,input_hashes:5,literal_stdout_hashes:10,native_predicates:42,reference_predicates:25,all_match:true})
